name: hostbook
description: Phone-first party hosting planner: guests, who brings what, arrival times, tasks, notes.

scripts.test:e2e: firebase emulators:exec --only auth,database --project demo-hostbook 'playwright test --project=pixel-7 --project=galaxy-s22 && playwright test --project=iphone --workers=2'
scripts.test:emulator: firebase emulators:exec --only auth,database --project demo-hostbook 'vitest run --config vitest.emulator.config.ts'
scripts.build:e2e: VITE_FIREBASE_API_KEY=demo-key VITE_FIREBASE_AUTH_DOMAIN=demo-hostbook.firebaseapp.com VITE_FIREBASE_DATABASE_URL='http://127.0.0.1:9000?ns=demo-hostbook-default-rtdb' VITE_FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID=demo-hostbook VITE_FIREBASE_APP_ID=demo-app VITE_FIREBASE_EMULATOR_HOST=127.0.0.1 vite build --outDir dist-e2e --emptyOutDir
